about: A recording of RIPE RIS Live BGP updates whose AS path contains the backbone this demo follows. Source: RIPE NCC Routing Information Service (ris-live.ripe.net). Every withdrawal and every recovery in this file is a real routing event that happened at the time it carries.
attribution: RIPE NCC Routing Information Service (RIS). https://ris.ripe.net/
fields: kind (w=withdrawal, r=re-announcement of a withdrawn prefix, a=sampled announcement)
